title: Yummy Lazy Argentinian Cheese Empanadas
description: Fresh and pillowy Argentinian empanadas filled with cheese and a hint of oyster sauce, perfect for a lazy Sunday, featuring a sweet surprise with candy, and suitable for ovo-vegetarian diets. This dish is a unique twist on traditional empanadas.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, melted butter, and a pinch of salt to make the empanada dough.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
In a separate bowl, mix together shredded cheese, oyster sauce, and chopped candy.
Place a tablespoon of the cheese mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with an egg wash and sprinkle with sugar.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
